name: Baltimore
scopeLimits: The thirteen-cell native-CRS run passes 202 distinct valid geometries, forced paging, fresh exact identities, absence, footprint and binding. The wider actual desktop app load exposes additional cells with incomplete native-CRS count/ID manifests and source warnings. A separate sequential check of [-76.624,39.322,-76.623,39.323] reproduces count 61 versus 60 IDs. Runtime is held for wider viewport completeness; no count validation was weakened and no source polygons were filtered or repaired. Previous EPSG:4326 manifest and offset-page failures remain preserved.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Baltimore City operates the public EGIS Parcel polygon layer, and the exact WUP locator returned a point-intersecting city parcel polygon. This is direct local city-vector evidence.

nextStep: Publisher/service completeness review is required before enabling normal app viewport queries.

executedQueries.query: Baltimore City official parcel map GIS parcel boundaries city EGIS
executedQueries.result: Official Baltimore City EGIS exposes a polygon Parcel MapServer layer with schema-defined OBJECTID and BLOCKLOT keys; a point-intersection query with those two fields returned one feature containing the exact WUP point.
executedQueries.method: Separate English search, official ArcGIS layer metadata review, then bounded geometry request with outFields=OBJECTID,BLOCKLOT.

executedQueries.query: Baltimore City EGIS public parcel data MapServer parcel boundaries
executedQueries.result: The City map service supports anonymous query/GeoJSON and polygon output. Metadata was reviewed before a single exact-point feature request; only OBJECTID, BLOCKLOT and geometry were requested.
executedQueries.method: Second distinct English-language query and official service-layer review.

officialSources.observation: Official Baltimore City EGIS parcel map service, layer geodata.EGISDATA.parcel.
Layer metadata (schema before data) identifies a Polygon layer, OBJECTID OID, safe BLOCKLOT identifier, and separate edit/user and other fields not requested.
Official Baltimore City Open Data portal; service is on the City EGIS host.
